description: Figure AI's $39B self-valuation, reported a week after its Series C actually closed. The only capture in the corpus touching an existing company note (Figure AI, alias 'Figure'), an existing person note (Brett Adcock), and an existing thread (Humanoid manipulation) — exercises correct entity extraction ahead of Enrich's routing. Revised 2026-10-27: the capture frames this as a valuation-sanity-check piece ('the valuation seemed... a bit off'), not a fresh funding announcement — Opus classified it `opinion` (commentary on whether the number is justified given near-zero revenue), a defensible read since the raise itself isn't new news here. The check no longer pins development_type; what actually matters for Enrich is that the entities are extracted correctly regardless of classification.
